job.title: D365 F&O - Finance
job.description:
Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O – Finance

We are seeking a Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O Functional Specialist to support our client and take ownership of Finance processes and systems. This role will partner closely with key stakeholders to deliver solutions, enhancements and continuous improvements across the D365 Finance platform.

About the Role As the primary functional lead for Finance, you will work closely with Finance and IT stakeholders to understand business requirements, manage the Finance applications backlog and deliver fit-for-purpose solutions that improve business processes and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities
  • Act as the primary functional specialist for D365 Finance & Operations
  • Support and optimise core Finance processes and systems
  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to gather requirements and translate business needs into solutions
  • Manage and prioritise the Finance applications backlog
  • Lead requirements analysis, solution design, testing and delivery
  • Provide functional support and coordinate issue resolution with technical teams and vendors
  • Drive continuous improvement, automation and optimisation across D365 Finance
  • Develop functional documentation, user guides and training materials
About You
  • Demonstrated experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O, particularly Finance modules
  • Strong knowledge of GL, AP, AR, Fixed Assets, Project Accounting and Banking
  • Experience delivering full-cycle D365 F&O implementations
  • Strong Finance/accounting background
  • Experience in business analysis or functional consulting within ERP environments
  • Strong requirements gathering and process improvement skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to work effectively with senior business stakeholders and translate requirements into practical solutions

job.title: Junior - Mid Project Manager
job.description:
We are seeking a Project Manager with 5–10 years of experience to join our client on an initial 6-month temporary contract. This role will be responsible for the end-to-end delivery of projects.

A key requirement for this position is demonstrated experience managing Business & IT projects, including implementation, enhancement, transformation or related business systems initiatives.
Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of assigned projects from planning through to implementation and closure.
  • Manage project scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues, dependencies and quality.
  • Work closely with Business Owners, subject matter experts, technical teams and external vendors.
  • Manage Business & IT-related projects, ensuring business requirements, system impacts and delivery outcomes are clearly understood.
  • Support requirements gathering, business analysis and assessment of impacts across business processes and operating models.
  • Prepare project plans, governance documentation, status reports, meeting packs, minutes and risk/issue registers.
  • Facilitate project working groups and stakeholder meetings.
  • Identify and escalate key risks, issues, dependencies and delivery challenges.
  • Coordinate internal teams and external vendors to ensure successful project outcomes.
  • Contribute to improving project management frameworks, tools and delivery practices.
Key Requirements
  • Strong end-to-end project management experience across scope, schedule, budget, risks, issues and dependencies.
  • Experience with implementation, enhancement, transformation or integration projects.
  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering capability.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Ability to work autonomously, manage ambiguity and take accountability for complex projects.
  • Experience working with internal teams, vendors and senior stakeholders.
  • Advanced Microsoft 365 skills and experience with project portfolio management tools.
  • Government or regulated industry experience is highly desirable.
  • Relevant tertiary qualification in Project Management, Business, Business Analysis or a related discipline.
  • PRINCE2, PMBOK, Agile or other relevant project management certification is desirable.
Eligibility

Applicants must be an Australian citizen, Australian permanent resident, or New Zealand citizen with a valid passport.
Travel to other work locations may be required.

Why Join?

This is an opportunity to contribute to meaningful projects within an organisation focused on delivering important outcomes for the Victorian community. You will work in a collaborative environment with opportunities to engage with business, technology and delivery stakeholders across the organisation.

job.title: Infra Solutions Architect
job.description:
Infrastructure Solution Architect
 
We are currently supporting our client in the search for an experienced Solution Architect to join their team.

You will work closely with business and technical stakeholders, project teams, vendors and the Enterprise Architecture function to develop effective, secure and scalable solutions across infrastructure, applications, information and technology domains.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design and deliver end-to-end solution architectures aligned with business requirements and strategic technology roadmaps.
  • Work with business stakeholders, Project Managers and Business Analysts to understand project objectives, requirements and constraints.
  • Evaluate and recommend technology solutions, considering cost, risk, security, scalability, performance and total cost of ownership.
  • Design secure server, network and Azure cloud solutions.
  • Facilitate architecture workshops and communicate technical solutions clearly to both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Develop and maintain current-state and future-state architecture documentation.
  • Contribute to architecture standards, principles, patterns, reference architectures and technology roadmaps.
  • Provide technical guidance, mentoring and thought leadership to project teams.
  • Conduct design reviews and ensure solutions align with agreed architecture standards and requirements.
  • Consider operational requirements including resilience, high availability, monitoring, maintainability and performance.
  • Work with vendors and external consultants to assess and develop appropriate technology solutions.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement across IT architecture, delivery and operational practices.
About You
  • 5+ years' experience designing and developing complex IT infrastructure solutions.
  • Proven experience taking accountability for solution architecture and technical outcomes.
  • Strong experience designing secure server, network and Azure cloud solutions.
  • Experience documenting solution architectures across business, application, information and technology domains.
  • Experience evaluating and selecting technology solutions and components.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to facilitate workshops and engage stakeholders at all levels.
  • Experience working across a variety of software development methodologies.
Desirable
  • Experience with enterprise architecture frameworks and notations such as TOGAF or ArchiMate.
  • Relevant architecture or cloud certifications.
 
What You'll Bring
 
You will be a collaborative and consultative technology professional who can operate across both business and technical environments. You will be comfortable acting as a trusted advisor, translating business requirements into practical technology solutions and contributing to the organization's broader technology strategy.

job.title: Technical Writer
job.description:
Our client is looking for Technical Writer in Melbourne on contract basis. This role focused on bringing SME inspection and test plans and standard operating procedures into one controlled library. You will work alongside site teams to capture how work is actually performed, then turn those methods into clear, repeatable documents with defined inspection points, evidence requirements and acceptance criteria. The role also produces the registers, checklists and forms those documents depend on, and hands over an indexed and maintainable library at the end of the engagement.

Key Responsibilities / Accountabilities
  • Write and format inspection and test plans to a single agreed SME standard.
  • Build the master ITP library so that inspection points, evidence requirements and acceptance criteria are consistent across projects.
  • Interview site teams to capture how tasks are actually performed.
  • Convert proven work methods into standard operating procedures with named owners, revision control and review dates.
  • Source acceptance criteria from project specifications, drawings and Australian Standards, and quote the values within the document.
  • Tailor generic ITPs and SOPs to contract requirements and project risks ahead of mobilisation.
  • Apply document numbering, revision control and approval workflow so that every document is traceable.
  • Maintain the document register and keep superseded versions clearly marked.
  • Incorporate review comments from the Quality Manager, engineering and site supervision.
  • Update ITPs and SOPs when non-conformances and lessons learned identify a gap.
  • Prepare supporting material such as visual work guides and pre-start aids where they improve uptake on site.
Qualifications:
  • Demonstrated experience in technical writing, documentation or procedure development.
  • Construction Industry General Safety Induction (White Card), or willingness to obtain one before attending site.
  • Current Australian driver’s licence, with the ability to travel between project sites.
If that suits please apply through ad.

job.title: Programmer / Scheduler - Primavera P6
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Primavera P6 Programmer / Scheduler to join a central PMO and provide scheduling support across a portfolio of complex projects.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who enjoys working across multiple projects and contractors, with responsibility for developing robust, resource-loaded programmes and providing accurate reporting to support project delivery and commercial outcomes.

You will be responsible for:
  • Developing, updating and maintaining Primavera P6 programmes across multiple concurrent projects
  • Building and managing resource-loaded schedules, ensuring resource allocation and forecasting remain accurate
  • Establishing and maintaining project structures including EPS, OBS, WBS and activity coding
  • Producing programme reporting and Power BI dashboards using P6 data to provide visibility of progress, productivity and performance
  • Managing baselines, progress updates and rolling lookahead programmes
  • Monitoring critical paths, programme logic, milestones and schedule performance
  • Ensuring programmes are maintained to a standard that provides clear and defensible evidence for EOT and variation claims
  • Working closely with Project Managers, Program Managers, commercial teams and contractors to align programmes with project and contractual requirements
  • Supporting consistent scheduling processes, coding standards and governance across the portfolio
  • Managing P6/XER file exchanges with head contractors and subcontractors
About You:
You will have 5+ years' hands-on Primavera P6 experience, with a strong background in resource-loaded programming and schedule management.

You'll ideally bring:
  • Strong Primavera P6 capability, including resource loading and resource levelling
  • Experience working across construction, infrastructure or engineering projects
  • A solid understanding of critical path methodology, programme logic and schedule analysis
  • Experience developing Power BI reporting from P6 data
  • Experience working with multiple projects, contractors and stakeholders simultaneously
  • An understanding of programme requirements relating to EOTs, variations and commercial claims
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work effectively with project teams, contractors and senior stakeholders

What's on offer?
  • $160k - $170k + Super
  • Permanent employment
  • Onsite/ in office 4+ days p/w
  • Inner-West suburbs of Melbourne location

job.title: Implementation Lead
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Implementation Lead with strong Primavera P6 expertise to lead the implementation and rollout of P6 across a portfolio of complex projects.

This is a highly hands-on role, working directly alongside an established scheduling team to configure P6, uplift existing schedules and establish consistent scheduling practices. A key focus will be resource loading and resource allocation, ensuring project schedules provide accurate and meaningful visibility of project resources.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Configure Primavera P6, including EPS, OBS, WBS and activity coding
  • Establish and roll out resource-loaded schedules across live projects
  • Review and uplift existing schedules and migrate them into P6
  • Develop consistent scheduling standards, coding conventions and governance
  • Establish effective resource loading and allocation methodologies
  • Work closely with the in-house scheduling team, providing hands-on training and mentoring
  • Establish file exchange processes with head contractors
  • Support the development of accurate, consistent and defensible schedules suitable for EOT and variation claims
  • Document the agreed scheduling "way of working" once proven across live projects
About You:
  • 5+ years' hands-on Primavera P6 experience
  • Demonstrated experience with P6 implementation and configuration, not simply schedule maintenance
  • Strong understanding of resource loading and resource allocation
  • Experience working across construction, infrastructure or engineering environments
  • The ability to work directly with scheduling teams and embed new processes and ways of working
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to train and mentor existing schedulers
  • A practical, hands-on approach and the ability to operate effectively within a live project environment
What's on offer?
  • Rates to be discussed.
  • Initial 3-6 month engagement.
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location.

job.title: Data Engineer
job.description:
We’re looking for an experienced Data Engineer to join our client's team on an inital 5-month contract in Melbourne.

You’ll be responsible for designing and developing reliable data pipelines, maintaining data models and supporting the delivery of high-quality data assets for reporting, analytics and business operations. You’ll work closely with Data, BI, Technology and business stakeholders to understand requirements and deliver practical data solutions.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Design, develop, test and deploy data pipelines and core datasets
  • Build and maintain data models and data warehouse capabilities
  • Develop and manage ELT/ETL processes, particularly using dbt
  • Work with Snowflake to support data integration, reporting and analytics
  • Monitor data processes and resolve operational and data quality issues
  • Maintain clear documentation across pipelines, models and datasets
  • Support data governance, security, access controls and PII protection
  • Collaborate with technical and business stakeholders to deliver data solutions
  • Provide technical input into the ongoing improvement of the data platform
About You:
You’ll have 5+ years’ experience in data engineering or technology, with strong hands-on capability across:
  • SQL
  • Snowflake
  • DBT
  • Data modelling
  • ETL/ELT and data pipeline development
  • Data platform design and integration
  • Experience with Azure Functions, Azure DevOps, GitHub, Fivetran and Power BI will be highly regarded.
You’ll be a strong communicator who can work autonomously, manage competing priorities and translate business requirements into practical technical solutions. Attention to detail, a collaborative approach and a positive attitude are essential.

What's on offer?
  • Circa $900 p/d
  • Intial 5-month contract - Extensions likely
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location - Hybrid work environment

job.title: Chris21 Technical Analyst
job.description:
About the Role
 
We are seeking a People Systems Analyst – Chris21 to join our client and support the ongoing administration, maintenance and improvement of their People Systems environment.

This role will support People Systems development initiatives, including solution consultation and design, testing and implementation. You will also be responsible for coordinating and resolving People Systems incidents, support requests and queries, working closely with IT and People/Payroll stakeholders.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Provide day-to-day support for Chris21 and related People Systems.
  • Participate in payroll and payroll-related activities.
  • Support the administration, nominal development and ongoing maintenance of People Systems applications.
  • Coordinate and resolve People Systems incidents, queries and support requests.
  • Contribute to system improvements, enhancements and initiatives.
  • Assist with solution consultation, design, testing and implementation activities.
  • Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, People teams and external technology vendors.
  • Ensure work is appropriately prioritised and delivered within agreed schedules.
  • Maintain accurate system documentation and records.
To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • Tertiary qualifications or equivalent experience in IT, Computing or a related discipline.
  • Up to 3 years' experience in information systems or applications support.
  • Experience working with HRIS or People Systems.
  • Basic experience supporting Chris21.
  • An understanding of software development methodologies and concepts, particularly in relation to HR systems, payroll, and time & attendance.
  • Experience or understanding of payroll-related systems and processes.
  • Ability to contribute to system improvements and business initiatives.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Good planning, organisation and time management skills.
  • Strong customer service and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to prioritise and deliver work in line with agreed schedules.
  • Experience with document and records management.
  • Strong computer literacy, including Microsoft Office applications.

If you have experience with Chris21, HRIS, payroll systems or HR application support, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Integration Engineer
job.description:
About the role 

Integration Engineer We are seeking an experienced AIS Integration Engineer to develop, test, implement, and support enterprise integrations across on-premises, SaaS, and cloud applications.

Key Responsibilities

job.title: Systems Engineer (Endpoint / Modern Workplace)
job.description:
Systems Engineer (Endpoint / Workplace)

About the Role
We are seeking an experienced Systems Engineer (Endpoint / Workplace) to join a large enterprise environment, with a key focus on SCCM to Microsoft Intune migration, endpoint management and enterprise patching.
This is a hands-on technical role for someone with strong experience across Microsoft SCCM / Configuration Manager and Intune, particularly within environments transitioning from traditional SCCM-based management to modern Intune endpoint management.
A major focus will be patching and endpoint compliance, ensuring Windows devices and applications remain secure, current and effectively managed across a large, distributed environment.
Key Responsibilities
  • Play a key role in the migration and transition from SCCM to Microsoft Intune.
  • Assess and transition existing SCCM applications, configurations, policies and workloads into Intune.
  • Manage and improve enterprise-wide patching, including Windows updates, security patches, application patching, compliance and remediation.
  • Manage application packaging, software deployment and endpoint configurations across SCCM and Intune.
  • Configure and maintain Intune policies, profiles, applications and endpoint management capabilities.
  • Troubleshoot SCCM, Intune, deployment and patching issues across a large enterprise environment.
  • Develop and maintain operating system deployments and endpoint configurations.
  • Use PowerShell and automation to improve deployment, patching and endpoint management processes.
  • Test and validate hardware, drivers, BIOS and firmware updates.
  • Work with project and operational teams on endpoint migration, transition and workplace technology initiatives.
  • Support the successful transition of new technologies and services into BAU operations.
Key Skills & Experience
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft SCCM / Configuration Manager.
  • Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Intune and modern endpoint management.
  • Demonstrated experience with SCCM to Intune migration, transition or co-management.
  • Strong experience with enterprise patch management, including Windows and application patching, security updates, compliance and remediation.
  • Strong knowledge of Windows endpoint infrastructure, deployment and management.
  • Experience with application packaging and software deployment.
  • Strong PowerShell scripting and automation skills.
  • Experience troubleshooting complex endpoint, deployment and patching issues.
  • Experience working within a large enterprise or geographically distributed environment.
  • Previous experience within retail or another large distributed environment would be highly regarded.
  • Experience delivering migration and transition projects through to BAU.
This is an excellent opportunity for a hands-on Systems Engineer to play a key role in a significant SCCM to Intune transformation, with responsibility for improving endpoint management, automated patching and compliance across a complex enterprise environment.

job.title: Senior Network Engineer
job.description:
Senior Network Engineer

About the Role
 
We are seeking an experienced Senior Network Engineer to provide high-level engineering support across a large university network environment. The role will be responsible for the design, installation, configuration, management and ongoing support of LAN, WAN, wireless, Voice over IP and network security infrastructure.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Design, support and administer LAN, WAN, wireless and voice network environments.
  • Install, configure and maintain Cisco routers, switches and network hardware.
  • Design and manage network security infrastructure, including firewalls, load balancers and VPNs.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex network and infrastructure issues.
  • Provide Level 3 escalation support for complex network problems.
  • Monitor network performance, capacity, utilisation and security.
  • Support enterprise-wide network projects, technology deployments and infrastructure upgrades.
  • Maintain network documentation, including network diagrams and disaster recovery documentation.
  • Work collaboratively with internal IT teams, suppliers and stakeholders.
  • Participate in an on-call roster and respond to critical incidents when required.
About You
  • Degree-level qualification in IT, Information Systems or equivalent.
  • Relevant industry certification such as CCNP/CCIE, or equivalent experience.
  • Substantial experience designing and managing large multi-site networks with 5,000+ nodes.
  • Strong experience with Cisco routers, switches and network hardware.
  • Experience with Cisco IOS and NX-OS.
  • Strong enterprise routing and network troubleshooting experience.
  • Experience designing and managing enterprise multi-site wireless networks.
  • Experience with network security, VPNs and firewalls.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving and communication skills.
Desirable: Experience with Cumulus Linux, PAN-OS, MPLS/VRF Lite, Linux administration, data-center virtualization, software-defined networking, load balancing and automation tools such as Ansible, Puppet and Git.

job.title: Product Information & Migration Lead
job.description:
We are looking for an experienced Product Information & Migration Lead to join a major ERP transformation program.

This role will be responsible for preparing a large and complex product catalogue for migration from legacy systems into a new ERP platform. With potentially 100,000+ products/SKUs, you will bring structure and consistency to existing product information and develop the approach for cleansing, mapping, validating and migrating it into the new system.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead the product information and master data workstream for the ERP transformation.
  • Review and catalogue existing product and SKU information across legacy systems.
  • Define the future-state product structure, including classifications, attributes and units of measure.
  • Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete, obsolete or poor-quality data.
  • Develop the Product Information & Migration Plan.
  • Map legacy product data to the new ERP structure.
  • Define data cleansing, transformation and validation requirements.
  • Work with technical teams and implementation partners to deliver the migration.
  • Coordinate data testing, reconciliation, migration rehearsals, cutover and go-live.
  • Facilitate workshops with business SMEs to understand requirements and agree the future-state approach.
  • Establish data quality standards, governance and ownership.
  • Manage migration risks, issues, dependencies and key decisions.
About You You will be an experienced Master Data, Product Information, Data Migration or ERP professional with a strong understanding of complex data environments.

Ideally, you will have:
  • Experience with master data, product information, data migration or ERP transformation.
  • Experience working with large product/SKU catalogues or high-volume datasets.
  • Strong understanding of product hierarchies, classifications, attributes and relationships.
  • Experience with data cleansing, mapping, validation and reconciliation.
  • Experience developing migration strategies and plans.
  • Strong business analysis and requirements gathering skills.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and workshop facilitation skills.
  • Experience working with ERP implementation teams, systems integrators or external vendors.
  • A hands-on and pragmatic approach, with the ability to work through ambiguity and drive outcomes.
Desirable Experience with:
  • Retail, FMCG, manufacturing, distribution or supply chain environments.
  • Large-scale SKU/product migrations.
  • PIM or MDM platforms.
  • SAP, Microsoft Dynamics, Oracle or other major ERP platforms.
  • Complex ERP transformation programs.

What's on offer?
  • Circa $200k package
  • Initial 24-month FTC
  • Nearby Melbourne CBD location.
  • 3-4 days p/w in office.

job.title: Service Desk Lead
job.description:
Service Desk Lead in Perth | Permanent Role

We’re looking for an experienced Service Desk Lead to lead a small team across Australia and help shape the next evolution of the organisation’s technology support function.
This is broader than simply managing a Service Desk. We’re looking for someone who combines strong people leadership and technical credibility with a genuine appetite for innovation. You’ll be responsible for delivering a great end-user experience today, while also looking at how AI, automation and smarter ways of working can improve the service of tomorrow.
The Role You’ll lead and develop a team of approximately 5–6 people, creating a high-performing and customer-focused Service Desk that works closely with teams across the broader Technology function.
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Lead, coach and develop the Service Desk team, building capability and creating a strong culture of accountability and continuous improvement.
  • Drive a consistently positive end-user experience, ensuring the Service Desk is seen as a trusted and professional technology partner.
  • Provide technical leadership and direction, supporting the team through more complex issues and escalations.
  • Identify opportunities to introduce AI, automation, self-service and other emerging technologies to improve efficiency and the overall support experience.
  • Maintain strong operational standards across ticket management, prioritisation, escalations and service performance.
  • Build effective relationships across Infrastructure, EUC, Applications, Platforms, Identity and Cyber Security, ensuring issues are resolved collaboratively.
  • Work alongside project teams to understand upcoming technology changes, assess support requirements and help transition new services effectively into BAU.
About You You’ll have experience leading a Service Desk, IT Support or Service Delivery function within an enterprise environment, with a track record of developing people and improving service outcomes.
You’ll bring strong technical knowledge across areas such as Microsoft 365, Active Directory, Identity & Access Management, End User Computing and common enterprise applications. You don't necessarily need to be the person resolving every technical issue yourself, but you should be technically capable enough to lead the team, challenge thinking, understand complex issues and engage credibly with specialist technology teams.
We’re particularly interested in someone who is curious about the future of Service Operations.

You’ll naturally look for better ways of doing things and be excited by the opportunity to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve self-service and create a more proactive support model.
You’ll also be a calm and pragmatic leader who communicates well, builds strong stakeholder relationships and is comfortable balancing BAU priorities alongside a busy pipeline of technology change.
The Opportunity This is a chance to take ownership of an established Service Desk while having genuine scope to develop the team, improve the service and introduce new ideas.

For someone who brings together people leadership, technical capability, customer focus and innovation, there’s a real opportunity to make an impact on how Technology support is delivered across the organisation.
